notes:
Summary: Peregrine builds an internal code search product for engineering orgs (1000s of repos). Primary ask = embeddings + reranking pipeline that scales to tens of millions of vectors with frequent (nightly) re-indexes. Key constraints: SSO/SAML + SCIM for provisioning, strict data residency (US-East), and max budget per query for reranker.

Technical requirements (from call):
- Corpus size: testing 5M embeddings in POC, long-term target 30-50M vectors. Many small files, fragmented tokens.
- Re-index cadence: nightly full/partial pipelines; need delta-updates < 30min end-to-end for hot repos.
- Latency SLO: P95 < 150ms for retrieval + < 300ms end-to-end when reranker enabled (target).
- Throughput: peak 200 qps during internal developer hours; background batch ingestion saturates GPU nodes overnight.
- Cost guardrails: target cost per query (including reranking) <= $0.02; highly cost-sensitive for non-customer-facing internal tooling.
- Architecture ask: bi-encoder ANN store for candidate recall + cross-encoder fine-tuned reranker for top-K re-ranking. Interested in comparing Redwood Optimize quantization + batching vs their current FAISS CPU footprint.
- Model preferences: open-code-embed or equivalent open models for embeddings (quantized), plus small cross-encoder for rerank (can be hosted or fallback to Redwood Dedicated).

Security / Compliance:
- SAML 2.0 enforced, SCIM for user sync, customer KMS for key control, audit logs retention 1 year. Data residency must not leave us-east-1.
- Quote from SecOps: "No data egress to non-US regions; encryption keys must be customer-controlled."

POC plan (agreed):
- Day 0: infra kickoff + SAML metadata exchange
- Day 1-2: ingest 5M sample vectors via Redwood connector (incremental ingest test)
- Day 3-5: run candidate retrieval experiments (HNSW/IVF+PQ) and cross-encoder reranker comparisons, measure P95 and cost per query
- Day 6: resiliency testing (nightly re-index simulation), failover to fallback model variant
- Day 7: wrap-up, share metrics dashboard + draft contract RIs/capacity sizing

Stated concerns / quotes:
- "If we can't keep P95 under 150ms with reranker at scale, this won't replace our current homegrown system."
- "We re-index many repos every night; ingest throughput and delta-updates are make-or-break."
